entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2667 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
entries.review_state: Official English EUR-Lex text and instrument identity reviewed on 2026-10-23; the Croatian route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. The act amends the Visa Code, VIS and related instruments; it is not a consolidated Visa Code. Article 8(2) sets general application from the Commission decision under Article 7(1), with exceptions in Article 8(3). Verify the decision and Croatian participation before treating the EU Visa Application Platform as operational. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1191 simplifying requirements for certain public documents
entries.review_state: The official English text and Article 2 scope were reviewed on 2026-10-23. It covers specified Member-State public documents, including marriage and parentage records; Article 2(3) excludes third-country public documents and Article 2(4) excludes recognition of the legal effects of another Member State's document. The Croatian route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2685 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
entries.review_state: Official English text and instrument identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. This amending act changes the uniform visa format to a digital format, but Article 3 defers general application to a Commission implementing decision under Article 2(1), with a limited exception for Article 1 point 2 from 27 December 2023. Check the decision in the Official Journal before describing digital visas as operational. This is not a consolidated text of Regulation (EC) No 1683/95. The Croatian route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2018/1240 establishing ETIAS
entries.review_state: EUR-Lex identifies the current consolidated version dated 12 June 2026. Article 2(1)(c) covers visa-exempt third-country family members of Union citizens or equivalent free-movement beneficiaries who lack the specified residence card or permit; Article 2(2)(b)-(c) excludes qualifying cardholders. On 2026-10-23 the official ETIAS FAQ said the system was not operating and no applications were being collected; the Commission scheduled launch for Q4 2026 without an exact date. Recheck official operational status and the actual residence document before applying. The Croatian route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

Scope: Article 20 TFEU and the exceptional derived residence position where refusal would deprive a Union-citizen child of the genuine enjoyment of the substance of Union citizenship rights. entries.title: CJEU judgment SM (Child placed under Algerian kafala), C-129/18
entries.review_state: Official InfoCuria judgment record reviewed on 2026-10-23: 26 March 2019, ECLI:EU:C:2019:248; language of the case: English. English-language Court record linked. Scope: A child under Algerian kafala is not a direct descendant under Directive 2004/38 Article 2(2)(c); the host Member State must facilitate entry and residence after an individual assessment under Article 3(2)(a). The source remains external-only; no local copy, country-topic coverage, or country completion is implied.

entries.title: CJEU judgment Stolichna obshtina, rayon “Pancharevo” (V.M.A.), C-490/20

entries.title: CJEU judgment Mirin, C-4/23

entries.title: Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 (Brussels IIb) on jurisdiction, recognition and enforcement in matrimonial matters and parental responsibility, and on international child abduction
entries.review_state: Official EUR-Lex record and source identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. EUR-Lex current consolidated text displayed as 2 July 2019; no later consolidation was listed in the record reviewed on 23 October 2026. Scope: Jurisdiction, recognition and enforcement for covered matrimonial and parental-responsibility decisions, and international child abduction. It excludes adoption decisions and does not establish parentage. Limitations: Check the applicable case-date, national procedural implementation, and any later act-specific amendments before relying on a provision. External-only reference; no local copy or country-topic coverage/completion is implied.

entries.title: Council Regulation (EU) 2022/922 on the Schengen evaluation and monitoring mechanism
entries.review_state: Official EUR-Lex record and source identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. Official Journal act published 15 June 2022; in force and applicable from 1 October 2022; EUR-Lex displayed no consolidated version on 23 October 2026. Scope: Peer evaluation and monitoring of application of the Schengen acquis, including visas, external borders, return, information systems, agency and private-service activities, and fundamental-rights safeguards. Limitations: This is an oversight/evaluation mechanism, not an individual complaint or appeal procedure; evaluation reports may be restricted. External-only reference; no local copy or country-topic coverage/completion is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2019/1896 establishing the European Border and Coast Guard
entries.review_state: Official EUR-Lex record and source identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. Latest consolidated version listed by EUR-Lex on 23 October 2026, dated 31 December 2023; the record includes the 2021/1134 amendment. Scope: European Border and Coast Guard/Frontex mandate, joint operations, standing corps, fundamental-rights oversight and complaints, and Member-State responsibilities. Limitations: This does not set individual visa or residence-card eligibility rules. Review related implementing measures and national responsibilities for the issue at hand. External-only reference; no local copy or country-topic coverage/completion is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2019/817 on interoperability of EU information systems in the borders and visa fields
entries.review_state: Official EUR-Lex record and source identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. Current EUR-Lex consolidated version dated 12 June 2026; record last reviewed by EUR-Lex on 28 August 2026. Scope: Interoperability of border and visa information systems, including identity matching, search, data access, correction, erasure and oversight safeguards. Limitations: System components have staged operational dates set by separate implementing decisions; do not infer a component's operational status from the consolidated regulation alone. External-only reference; no local copy or country-topic coverage/completion is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2019/818 on interoperability of EU information systems for police/judicial cooperation, asylum and migration
entries.review_state: Official EUR-Lex record and source identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. Current EUR-Lex consolidated version dated 12 June 2026; record states that version is in force. Scope: Interoperability for police and judicial cooperation, asylum and migration, including data-access and data-protection rules. Limitations: System components have staged operational dates set by separate implementing decisions; check the relevant component, purpose and national authority before relying on it. External-only reference; no local copy or country-topic coverage/completion is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2025/13 on advance passenger information for law-enforcement purposes
entries.review_state: Official EUR-Lex record and source identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. EUR-Lex current consolidated version dated 8 January 2025, corrected by Corrigendum OJ L 90502 of 17 June 2025. Scope: Collection and router transfer of API and other PNR data for prevention, detection, investigation and prosecution of terrorism and serious crime on extra-EU and selected intra-EU flights. Limitations: This is distinct from Regulation (EU) 2025/12 on border-control API. Consult the corrigendum, commencement provisions, and Member-State intra-EU flight notifications before applying. External-only reference; no local copy or country-topic coverage/completion is implied.

entries.title: Council Directive 2001/51/EC on carrier obligations and sanctions under Article 26 of the Schengen Convention
entries.review_state: Official EUR-Lex record and source identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. Original Official Journal text, 28 June 2001. EUR-Lex displayed no consolidated-text link in the record checked on 23 October 2026; later transposition/currentness was not determined. Scope: Carrier return duties and financial penalties related to transporting third-country nationals without required travel documents; the Directive excludes international-protection cases from its financial-penalty rule. Limitations: National transposition and application must be checked separately; this is not a general entry-eligibility rule. External-only reference; no local copy or country-topic coverage/completion is implied.
